questionPrompt: In many countries, there is increasing competition for jobs. What are the causes of this, and what measures can be taken to address it?
passageText: Being a competitive job market, candidates must improve their skills constantly. The committee announced that they would review their policy next month. When an employee makes a mistake, you should not punish them too harshly. Having analysed the data, the conclusion was clear: only investing in people leads to long-term growth.
